'''Nazy''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. He was part of a group that were stranded on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] in [[4 BBY]] following an [[Ambush of the Maya Pei Brigade|attack on the brigade]]. 

==Biography==
By [[4 BBY]], Nazy had joined the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] to fight against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], the brigade was [[Ambush of the Maya Pei Brigade|attacked]] and Nazy was apart of a group of at least sixteen members of the brigade that survived the attack and escaped aboard a [[starship]] that landed on [[Yavin 4]]. However [[Bardi's brother|one member]] of the group subsequently departed in the ship leaving Nazy and the rest of the group stranded on the [[moon]]. The brigade members later encountered an individual named [[Porko]] that they found near a clearing with a damaged [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan]]. A conflict arose which resulted in the [[death]] of Porko.<ref name="One Year Later" />

Two [[Standard day|days]] after being stranded on the moon [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], an associate of Porko, landed near the group in a [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|stolen]] [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]]. As Andor approached the HOY-39 he called out for Porko only to have the Maya Pei group announced their presence and take Andor prisoner. Nazy watched as two members of the group [[Gerdis]] and [[Bardi]] took turns trying to interrogate Andor. However the interrogation was interrupted when [[Rika]], another member of the group, found the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[pilot]] [[helmet]] in the TIE and proclaimed that Andor was an imperial test pilot. Later that day, Nazy and two other members, [[Neek]] and [[Flek]] were assigned to guard Andor while Rika tried to learn to fly the TIE. A short conversation between the guards and Andor was interrupted and the three guards took cover when Rika pressed a button causing the TIE's [[laser cannon]]s to fire in to the [[jungle]] near the group.<ref name="One Year Later" /> 

That night, an argument between the group erupted when discussing who should be in charge ultimately coming to a head when [[Crab]] shot Rika with his [[blaster]] and [[Rowd]] responded by shooting Crab. The brigade members exchange fire between each other while splitting into two factions; with Nazy siding with Bardi, [[Musk]], Rowd, [[Tick (individual)|Tick]], Neek and [[Flu (individual)|Flu]] and regrouping at the TIE while the other group retreated to the crashed HOY-39.<ref name="One Year Later" /> After it began to rain later that night, Nazy crawled through the rain towards where Rika was shot to check if she was still alive. At the same time Snee, member of the other faction, was crawling through the rain looking for Crab's body. As Nazy proclaimed that he could not find Rika's body, Snee found a part of Crab's [[limb|leg]]. Freaking out, Snee ran back towards the HOY-39 while firing at the TIE group. Nazy fired over his shoulder while firing backwards before tripping and landing in the mud. When he made it back to the TIE he told the group he could only find Rika's [[goggles]].<ref name="Sagrona Teema">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref>

The following morning the [[Rowd]] a member of the group cut open a fowl smelling [[Yavin 4 melon]]. Nazy stood bace while the group were discussing whether to eat the it before Bardi eventually mustered up the courage and takes a bite. Later in day the group began trying to use rope to rotate the TIE so that its weapons would point towards the other group. When other group found out about the move they opened fire at the TIE forcing the Nazy's group to suspend their attempts. That night Gerdis decided to issue a challenge to Bardi to settle the dispute. The two groups cross towards each other before all dropping their weapons in unison. Nazy held a torch as they watched the two leaders engage in a game of [[Five Hands]] with [[Roski rules]]. While the group watched the game, Andor took the oppoescaped his captured and made his way to the TIE before he could get there a [[Yavinian doodar]] came out of the [[jungle]] and scooped Bardi and Gerdis in it's mouth. The rest of the group, including Nazy scrambled for their guns and began to shoot wildly into the jungle. When the group realized that Andor had made it to the TIE and was taking off the group began shooting at the TIE but were unable to stop it from leaving.<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />

==Personality and traits==
Nazy had tan skin, [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s and brown [[hair]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Equipment==
While stranded on Yavin 4 Nazy carried a [[blaster pistol]] and wore a long long grey and yellow [[jacket]], brown [[clothing|pants]], a brown [[belt]] and a brown [[hat]]. When it was raining on Yavin Nazy utilized the hood of his jacket to block the rain.<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nazy was portrayed by [[Dylan Blore]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's first and second episodes, "[[One Year Later]]" and "[[Sagrona Teema]]," which were both released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
